column1: # falcon-boot: scorecard cells the release gate accepts as changed.
# tools/coverage/scorecard-diff.py reads this beside itself. A cell listed
# here that was PASS in master's scorecard and is not now is reported as
# accepted, with its reason, and is neither a regression nor rerun. Every
# line is a cell the merge request into master is asked to review; when the
# release's scorecard lands on master, the list is emptied.
# Columns, tab-separated: id, state, route (run-corpus.sh's terms), reason.
